name: AWS Change Freeze Guard
description: Change-freeze and maintenance-window control, evaluated locally from the clock: infrastructure changes during declared freeze windows need admin approval (the break-glass path), prod changes outside business hours and any change on a weekend need a written reason, and Friday-afternoon changes draw a warning. Windows, timezone and hours are edited in each rule's Rego after install.

rules.name: Require access request for infrastructure changes during a declared change freeze
rules.description: Terraform/CDK/SAM/Pulumi applies, CloudFormation stack operations, Kubernetes/Helm rollouts and direct service mutations are held during declared freeze windows. Requires admin approval (the break-glass override). Edit freeze_windows in the rule's Rego after install — it ships with a year-end freeze from 18 Dec 2026 to 5 Jan 2027 as the example.

rules.name: Require justification for production infrastructure changes outside business hours
rules.description: A prod-targeted infrastructure change before 08:00 or after 18:00 (UTC by default — edit tz and the hours in the Rego) runs without an approver awake to catch it. Requires a written reason. Non-prod changes are not gated.

rules.name: Require justification for infrastructure changes on weekends
rules.description: Infrastructure changes on Saturday or Sunday (UTC by default — edit tz in the Rego) run without the normal on-call bench. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: Warn on Friday-afternoon infrastructure changes
rules.description: Changes after 15:00 on Friday (UTC by default — edit tz and the cutoff hour in the Rego) are debugged over the weekend when they break. Records a warning.

rule_config.rego:
package tracelet.policy

import rego.v1

default matched := false
default reason := ""

command := c if {
	c := object.get(input.event, "command_text", "")
	is_string(c)
}

default command := ""

# Commands that change deployed infrastructure (IaC apply/destroy, CFN
# stack operations, Kubernetes/Helm rollouts, direct service mutations).
infra_change_re := `(?:terraform|tofu)\s+(?:apply|destroy)\b|\bcdk\s+(?:deploy|destroy)\b|\bsam\s+(?:deploy|delete|sync)\b|\b(?:serverless|sls)\s+(?:deploy|remove)\b|\bpulumi\s+(?:up|destroy)\b|\baws\s+cloudformation\s+(?:create-stack|update-stack|delete-stack|deploy|execute-change-set)\b|\bkubectl\s+(?:apply|delete|rollout|scale|patch)\b|\bhelm\s+(?:install|upgrade|uninstall|rollback)\b|\baws\s+(?:ecs\s+update-service|lambda\s+update-function-(?:code|configuration)|eks\s+update-[a-z-]+|rds\s+(?:modify|delete|reboot)-[a-z-]+|ec2\s+(?:terminate|run|stop)-instances|autoscaling\s+update-auto-scaling-group|elbv2\s+(?:modify|delete)-[a-z-]+|route53\s+change-resource-record-sets)\b|\bansible-playbook\b|\beb\s+deploy\b|\bcopilot\s+(?:deploy|svc\s+deploy)\b`

infra_change if {
	command != ""
	regex.match(infra_change_re, command)
}

now_ns := time.now_ns()

# EDIT ME: timezone and the hour after which Friday deploys draw a warning.
tz := "UTC"
friday_cutoff_hour := 15

weekday := time.weekday([now_ns, tz])
hour := time.clock([now_ns, tz])[0]

matched if {
	infra_change
	weekday == "Friday"
	hour >= friday_cutoff_hour
}

reason := sprintf("Friday %02d:00 %s infrastructure change — anything that breaks now is debugged over the weekend; prefer Monday unless this is a fix", [hour, tz]) if {
	matched
}
